name: Net merchandise sales
numerator: Merchandise gross less discounts less merchandise refunds
main_caveat: Exclude VAT and shipping; reconcile refunds

name: Contribution before acquisition
numerator: Net merchandise plus retained shipping less COGS fulfillment freight fees commissions variable service
main_caveat: Missing costs are unknown not zero; not net profit

name: Contribution after acquisition
numerator: EC02 less allocated acquisition cost
main_caveat: Specify allocation; show fixed setup and overhead separately

name: Contribution margin
numerator: EC02
main_caveat: Zero revenue yields NA; tax excluded

name: Acquisition CAC blended
numerator: Acquisition-designated spend
main_caveat: Not causal; cost allocation and lag documented

name: Attributed paid CAC
numerator: Acquisition spend for selected channel
main_caveat: Model-dependent and cross-device blind spots

name: Attributed ROAS
numerator: Attributed net merchandise revenue
main_caveat: Not incremental profit; platform claims not summed

name: Net AOV
numerator: Net merchandise sales
main_caveat: Define partial refund policy; not client deck AOV until reconciled

name: First-order contribution
numerator: First valid order EC03 total
main_caveat: Test break-even claim after cost reconciliation

name: Observed 180-day contribution per buyer
numerator: Contribution within 180 days of first valid order
main_caveat: Observed value not lifetime value

name: Cost coverage
numerator: Net sales with all required cost fields
main_caveat: Coverage is separate from profitability

name: Discount intensity
numerator: Merchandise discounts
main_caveat: Separate sale events and value gifts

name: First-time valid buyers
numerator: Distinct buyers at first valid purchase
main_caveat: Incomplete history misclassifies existing buyers

name: Session purchase conversion
numerator: Measurable eligible sessions with valid purchase
main_caveat: Consent and cross-device gaps; not buyers divided by sessions

name: Meaningful ritual activation
numerator: Eligible entrants saving or choosing next ritual step
main_caveat: Proposed activation definition requires task validation

name: Quiz completion
numerator: Completed distinct quiz attempts
main_caveat: Process metric not ritual adoption

name: Recommendation usefulness
numerator: Positive optional usefulness responses
main_caveat: Self-selection; show invite response rate

name: 30-day second-purchase conversion
numerator: Matured buyers with subsequent valid purchase within 30 days
denominator: First buyers observed for full 30 days
main_caveat: Immature buyers excluded and shown separately

name: 60-day second-purchase conversion
numerator: Matured buyers with subsequent valid purchase within 60 days
denominator: First buyers observed for full 60 days
main_caveat: Cumulative conversion not calendar repeat share

name: 90-day second-purchase conversion
numerator: Matured buyers with subsequent valid purchase within 90 days
denominator: First buyers observed for full 90 days
main_caveat: Predeclare valid order refund rules

name: 180-day second-purchase conversion
numerator: Matured buyers with subsequent valid purchase within 180 days
denominator: First buyers observed for full 180 days
main_caveat: Not subscription retention

name: Existing-buyer revenue share
numerator: Net revenue from orders after first valid purchase
main_caveat: Not customer repeat rate; supplied 54 percent basis unresolved

name: Ritual expansion purchase
numerator: Matured buyers purchasing a distinct recommended ritual step within 90 days
denominator: Eligible first ritual buyers observed for full 90 days
main_caveat: Does not prove use; gifts and bundles separated

name: Referral buyer conversion
numerator: Valid first buyers linked to referral landing
main_caveat: Code leakage and attribution limitations

name: Voluntary reported practice days
numerator: Reported days ritual used in last seven days
main_caveat: Self-reported nonclinical and response-biased

name: Check-in response
numerator: Valid voluntary respondents
main_caveat: Do not infer practice among nonrespondents

name: Ritual feasibility
numerator: Respondents rating ritual feasible
main_caveat: Instrument wording fixed; include time burden feedback

name: Heritage explanation respect
numerator: Respondents rating explanation respectful
main_caveat: No ethnic profiling; qualitative feedback alongside score

name: Thread motif comprehension
numerator: Participants correctly explaining intended reviewed meaning
main_caveat: Small purposive sample not population estimate

name: Community repeat participation
numerator: Consented participants attending another session within window
main_caveat: Not religious identity or customer retention

name: Qualified account conversion
numerator: Accounts satisfying documented fit and agreed next step
main_caveat: Deduplicate multi-contact accounts

name: Pilot activation
numerator: Qualified accounts beginning agreed pilot or training
denominator: Matured qualified accounts with opportunity window
main_caveat: Free sample is not first sale

name: First commercial-order conversion
numerator: Pilot accounts placing first commercial valid order
main_caveat: Long sales cycle and small samples

name: Eligible account reorder
numerator: Accounts reordering within agreed interval
denominator: First-order accounts observed for full interval
main_caveat: Do not use D2C replenishment window uncritically

name: Account contribution
numerator: Net wholesale sales less product servicing freight commissions samples training variable costs
main_caveat: Payment delays and relationship cost included separately

name: Partner sell-in
numerator: Units or net value shipped and invoiced to partner
main_caveat: Not guest consumer demand

name: Partner sell-through
numerator: Verified consumer units sold in period
denominator: Opening sellable stock plus receipts in period
main_caveat: Adjust stock transfers returns; treatment use separate

name: Partner bridge activation
numerator: Partner-coded entrants saving or choosing ritual
main_caveat: No guest identity required; scans do not imply stay counts

name: Overdue receivables
numerator: Unpaid invoice balance past agreed due date
main_caveat: Sales and cash collection differ

name: Organic search clicks
numerator: Search Console reported Web clicks
main_caveat: AI features may be bundled; query privacy gaps

name: Organic search CTR
numerator: Search Console Web clicks
main_caveat: Impression is not identifiable shopper exposure

name: Indexed priority-page coverage
numerator: Priority pages verified indexed
main_caveat: Indexed does not guarantee serving or citations

name: Observed mention rate
numerator: Valid category observations naming Mauli
main_caveat: Panel directional not category population

name: Observed recommendation rate
numerator: Valid category observations explicitly recommending Mauli
main_caveat: Mention not endorsement; no artificial top-five rule

name: Owned citation rate
numerator: Observations citing verified Mauli-owned URL
main_caveat: Citation is not attributable visit

name: Observed brand mention share
numerator: Mauli occurrences under fixed counting rule
denominator: All observed brand occurrences under same rule
main_caveat: Not market share or universal agent-mind

name: Answer claim accuracy
numerator: Correct assessable checked claims
main_caveat: Unverifiable separated; dynamic stock prices need timestamp

name: Unsupported health-claim incidence
numerator: Reviewed answers making unsupported health claims
main_caveat: Does not establish clinical efficacy

name: Citation drift
numerator: One minus matched-pair citation-set Jaccard overlap
main_caveat: Both empty NA; small sets unstable

name: Observed AI referrer purchases
numerator: Valid orders with observable allowlisted AI referrer under declared attribution
main_caveat: Undercoverage and missing referrers; not all AI influence

name: Declared AI discovery share
numerator: Respondents selecting AI as first discovery
main_caveat: Recall and response bias; not order attribution

name: Matured return incidence
numerator: Delivered valid orders with return in agreed post-delivery window
denominator: Delivered valid orders observed for full window
main_caveat: Not absence of harm or satisfaction

name: Complaint incidence
numerator: Eligible orders or accounts with recorded complaint
denominator: Eligible matured orders or accounts in same motion
main_caveat: Unknown support coverage; do not blend accounts and orders

name: Unsubscribe rate
numerator: Unique delivered-message recipients unsubscribing in agreed window
main_caveat: Delivery denominator; distinguish complaints

name: Human handoff completion
numerator: Requested handoffs completed under agreed criteria
main_caveat: No voice transcripts in public dataset

name: Motion accessibility task success
numerator: Participants completing core task with keyboard or reduced motion
main_caveat: Small test sample; pair with issue severity
